name: PDF as Markdown
description: A PDF read as a document rather than drawn as a page: headings, lists and tables, with the running heads, the page numbers and the line breaks of the page measure thrown away. Nothing is rendered and nothing third-party is shipped — the page as it stands is one Enter away, in whatever this machine already opens PDFs with.
author: xcommander

settings.label: Pages to read at most
settings.note: Nought reads the whole file, which is what a document wants. A number is for the thousand-page manual: only that many pages are read and the reading says so at the top. Reading is lazy either way, so a long file costs its length only once.

settings.label: Characters to show at most
settings.note: Nought shows all of it. A limit cuts at the end of a line rather than mid-word, and the reading says it was cut.
